name: Document Header Completeness
summary: Verify that the generated document contains all required header fields — recipient, sender, subject, and date — and that each field is non-empty and properly fo
purpose: Verify that the generated document contains all required header fields — recipient, sender, subject, and date — and that each field is non-empty and properly formatted. Missing or empty header fields indicate an incomplete document draft that fails minimum readiness standards.
assignment_instructions:
You are evaluating a document draft for header completeness.

Given the document draft provided by the user, inspect it for these four header fields:
1. recipient — Who the document is addressed to
2. sender — Who wrote or is sending the document
3. subject — The topic or purpose of the document
4. date — The date of the document (must be a valid date string)

Return a single JSON object with this exact structure:
{
  "assignment_id": "doc_recipient_sender_subject_v1",
  "agent_summary": "One sentence summary of header completeness status",
  "inputs_used": ["list of inputs you examined"],
  "missing_inputs": ["any inputs not provided"],
  "claims": [
    {"claim": "", "evidence_reference": "", "confidence": "provided | inferred | missing"}
  ],
  "header_fields": {
    "recipient": {"present": true, "value": "", "valid": true},
    "sender": {"present": true, "value": "", "valid": true},
    "subject": {"present": true, "value": "", "valid": true},
    "date": {"present": true, "value": "", "valid": true, "is_date_format": true}
  },
  "calculations": [],
  "risks": [],
  "assumptions": [],
  "open_questions": [],
  "final_output": "PASS or FAIL with reason",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}

Rules:
- A field is "present" if it exists and is non-empty.
- A field is "valid" if it contains meaningful content (not placeholder text like "TBD", "N/A", "[Fill in]")
- "is_date_format" must be true only if the date string is parseable as a date (YYYY-MM-DD, MM/DD/YYYY, etc.)
- final_output must be "PASS" only if ALL four fields are present AND valid.
- If any field is missing, invalid, or contains placeholder text, final_output must be "FAIL".
- Return only the JSON. No markdown fences, no prose explanation. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

audit_checks.label: Recipient field is missing or invalid
Sender field is missing or invalid
Subject field is missing or invalid
Date field is missing, invalid, or not a parseable date format
final_output is PASS but one or more header fields are missing or invalid — critical scoring error

deterministic_checks.description: recipient field must be present and valid
sender field must be present and valid
subject field must be present and valid
date field must be present, valid, and parseable as date
deterministic_checks.condition: header_fields.date.present == true AND header_fields.date.valid == true AND header_fields.date.is_date_format == true

deterministic_checks.description: final_output must be PASS only when all fields pass
deterministic_checks.condition: final_output == "PASS" implies all four fields are present and valid

evidence_checks.description: Each header field claim must reference the portion of the document where the field was found
Any missing or invalid header field must be listed in risks with severity "high"
